title: Heirloom: Carrying a Phone's Personalization Across Base-Model Generations
abstract: arXiv:2611.00650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-device language models can learn a user's preferences through adapters trained on private data. However, a base-model upgrade may change the layers or vocabulary, leaving the personal adapter incompatible. Replacing it with a non-personal adapter loses much of the personalization, while retraining requires retaining the user's labeled history. We present Heirloom, a system that transfers a personal adapter to a new base model on the phone without retaining labels. Heirloom uses the old personal model as a teacher, collecting its predictions on stored unlabeled inputs, vendor-provided prompts, or prompts generated by the new base. It then unloads the old base and trains an adapter for the new model to match those predictions, keeping only one base model in memory at a time. We evaluate Heirloom across three generation upgrades from two model families, an architecture-preserving refresh, and three personalization tasks. On movie taggi

translated_title: Heirloom：让手机上的个性化能力跨基模型代际传承
translated_abstract: 设备端语言模型可以通过在私有数据上训练的适配器来学习用户的偏好。然而，基模型升级可能会改变层结构或词表，导致个性化适配器不再兼容。用非个性化的适配器替换它会损失大部分个性化能力，而重新训练则需要保留用户带标签的历史数据。我们提出了Heirloom，这是一个无需保留标签即可在手机上将个性化适配器迁移到新基模型的系统。Heirloom使用旧的个性化模型作为教师，在存储的无标签输入、厂商提供的提示或由新基模型生成的提示上收集其预测结果。随后，它卸载旧的基模型，并训练新模型的适配器以匹配这些预测，同一时间内存中只保留一个基模型。我们在两个模型家族的三次代际升级、一次保持架构不变的更新以及三个个性化任务上对Heirloom进行了评估。
tldr: Heirloom提出了一种无需保留用户带标签数据的方法，通过将旧个性化模型作为教师在无标签数据上生成预测，在手机上将个性化适配器迁移到升级后的新基模型，且内存中仅需同时保留一个基模型。
